title: Understanding Residuals in OLS
text: In an Ordinary Least Squares (OLS) regression, the residuals are the differences between the observed values and the predicted values. The sum of these residuals is often zero, but there are conditions that must be met for this to be true.

title: Conditions for Sum of Residuals to be Zero
text: For the sum of residuals to be zero in an OLS model, the model must include an intercept term. This is because the intercept adjusts the model to ensure that the average of the residuals is zero.
